page.notes: Transcription is approximate. The scan is a double-column early modern page with heavy marginal notes and an illegible portion in the lower-left margin; the margin note placement is uncertain and several marginal readings are doubtful. Some Latin words in the margin (e.g. "Neemias", "Efdr", "Cic extra", "tra jocum", "anzaucil") are rendered from faint print and may be incorrect. The page is a two-column layout of Latin text (Sulpicius Severus-style Latin), with Hebrew/Greek absent on this page.
